name: dshd-pooler
description: Deepartments provider-adapter boot-check helpers for the pooler re-wire: the pure endpoint-drift detector (providerAdapterEndpointDrift + LOCAL_ENDPOINT_RE), the pure boot-findings resolver (resolveProviderAdapterBootFindings), and the dependency-free settings.yaml reader/parser (readLlmPiAiProviderSettings/parseLlmPiAiProviderSettings) — extracted for the dshd-pooler phase of the modular Cordis split. P1 (modularization, 2026-08-29): the package is NOW ALSO a Cordis PLUGIN (thin name/inject/apply + its own cordis.patch.yml row) providing the `deepartments.pooler` service (the provider-adapter boot check; the configured-provider list + post-error append inject via the FASE 2.6 binder `pooler` bucket — DECOUPLING); the bundle still consumes it through the drop-in bridge src/core/pooler.ts. The ONLY impure surface is the readFileSync in readLlmPiAiProviderSettings (the stateDir path is passed by parameter).
